description: No tool for trade-in values: say so, don't invent a figure

turns.message: What's my 2018 Honda Civic with 60,000 miles worth as a trade-in?

events.text:
I can't give you a trade-in value. My tools only search and show cars for sale, so I can't appraise your Civic. Carvana's own "Sell/Trade" page can give you an offer, and that's where you'd take the next step.

I can look up similar 2018 Honda Civics for sale near 94402 so you can see what they cost. Want me to do that?
